AIChatBubble now imports API from @/api (no direct process.env). rca of the issue: Static Cloudflare-cached React bundle at .preview.static.emergentagent.com was compiled with empty/wrong REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, so axios.baseURL became 'undefined/api' -> hit static origin -> SPA fallback / 404 for /auth/me. Fix (source-only): api.js now runtime-detects hostname; if '.preview.static.emergentagent.com', maps to '.preview.emergentagent.com' automatically. Verified via page.evaluate simulation: static hostname resolves to https://trip-billing-pro-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api (correct). Effective after next static rebuild.
